extracted.name: Slow Cooker Zucchini Soup
extracted.description: Simmer zucchini, Italian sausage, and canned tomatoes in a slow cooker for a hearty, weeknight meal.
ingredient_lines: 2 green bell peppers, cut into 1/2-inch slices
6 tablespoons grated Parmesan cheese, or to taste
instruction_lines: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add sausage; cook and stir until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain and discard grease. Stir in celery; cook and stir until softened, about 10 minutes. Transfer to a slow cooker.
Stir zucchini, diced tomatoes, bell peppers, onion, salt, sugar, oregano, Italian seasoning, basil, and garlic powder into sausage mixture.
Cook on Low for 4 to 6 hours. Garnish each serving with 1 tablespoon Parmesan cheese.
